article.title: transcosmos推出trans-AI Voice，把門店對話接到顧客資料與行銷跟進
article.title_en: transcosmos launches trans-AI Voice to connect offline conversations with customer data and follow-up
article.summary: transcosmos公布trans-AI Voice，結合對話記錄、AI洞察及顧客資料平台，把線下互動帶進銷售與行銷流程。
article.summary_en: transcosmos announced trans-AI Voice, combining conversation capture, AI insights and customer-data connections for sales and marketing workflows.
highlights: 涵蓋門店、商務會議及聯絡中心，透過Treasure AI Voice記錄及摘要。
對話可結合購買與行為資料，再接入CRM及行銷自動化；成效未經本刊驗證。
highlights_en: Treasure AI Voice captures and summarizes store, meeting and contact-center conversations.
Conversation data can join purchase and behavioral records and feed CRM and marketing automation; outcomes are not independently verified.
article.why: 線下顧慮可與交易資料對照後，零售及B2B團隊可決定哪些產品說明或跟進訊息需要修訂，而非只依賴前線印象。
article.why_en: Comparing offline concerns with transaction data can help retail and B2B teams prioritize product explanations and follow-up messages.
article.next_step: 選一類獲准記錄的門店諮詢，人工核對AI摘要中的購買顧慮，再與CRM記錄配對，測試一項針對性的跟進訊息。
article.next_step_en: Choose an authorized store-consultation category, check AI summaries of purchase concerns, match CRM records and test one targeted follow-up.
article.detail: VoC即顧客之聲，CDP則是整合顧客資料的平台。這次新服務把原本分散的線下對話與後續系統相連，屬公司公布的處理機制。AI摘要仍須與原對話核對，記錄範圍及用途亦應按實際場景確認。編輯建議先找出一項可追溯的顧慮與跟進決定，再評估訊息是否改善；本篇沒有把供應商對贏單率或收入的描述當成已證明結果。
article.detail_en: VoC means voice of the customer; a CDP unifies customer data. The announcement describes connecting fragmented offline dialogue to downstream systems. Check summaries against the conversation and confirm recording scope and purpose. Start with one traceable concern and follow-up decision; supplier statements do not establish higher win rates or revenue.
